stories.title: Bodhi Tree Systems buys majority stake in Adyar Ananda Bhavan
stories.summary: Bodhi Tree Systems will invest $180 million for a majority stake in the South Indian food chain Adyar Ananda Bhavan. The investment aims to support the chain's expansion across India and international markets. The restaurant group currently operates 160 domestic outlets and 30 locations abroad.

stories.title: Delhivery to add 2,000 electric vehicles to fleet
stories.summary: Logistics firm Delhivery plans to deploy up to 2,000 electric commercial vehicles across its intra-city network within 18 months. The company aims to make half of its intra-city fleet electric over the next three years, supported by partnerships with Tata Motors, Euler Motors, and Montra Electric.

stories.title: Ajinkya Rahane invests in cookware brand Ember
stories.summary: Former cricketer Ajinkya Rahane has acquired an undisclosed stake in Bengaluru-based D2C cookware brand Ember. The startup did not disclose financial terms for the investment. Ember plans to use the capital to expand its product categories and strengthen its distribution network.

stories.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet for AI-driven purchases
stories.summary: OpenAI has introduced ChatGPT Wallet, a feature allowing AI agents to make purchases using saved payment cards. Developed with American Express, Mastercard, and Visa, the system requires users to authorize each transaction via security checks like Face ID. The wallet replaces actual card details with tokens.

stories.title: Climate intelligence startup mistEO raises Rs 18 crore
stories.summary: Kerala-based mistEO has secured Rs 18 crore in seed funding led by MGF-Kavachh. The startup plans to use the capital to enhance its AI-powered weather forecasting and climate risk assessment capabilities. It intends to expand its Climate Decision Intelligence platform into new Asian markets.

stories.title: Google takes 1.43 percent stake in creator startup Rigi
stories.summary: Google has invested ₹10 crore in creator economy startup Rigi, valuing the company at ₹670 crore post-money. The platform, which allows users to watch micro-dramas without a subscription, plans to use the funds to expand its free-to-watch digital content portfolio.

stories.title: DLI-backed C2i Semiconductors raises $15 million from Peak XV, marking largest funding round for Indian chip startup - D
Reliance plans ₹1 lakh crore investment in Andhra Pradesh
stories.summary: Reliance intends to invest ₹1 lakh crore in Andhra Pradesh to establish compressed biogas plants. Executive director Anant M Ambani stated the project will generate ₹60,000 crore in state revenue and create three lakh job opportunities. The initiative is intended to strengthen India's energy security.

stories.title: Sachin Tendulkar invests in waste management firm Recykal
stories.summary: Former cricketer Sachin Tendulkar has become a strategic investor in Hyderabad-based waste management platform Recykal. The investment follows a $23 million bridge round closed in June. Tendulkar will assist the company in its campaign to encourage responsible waste disposal habits among the public.

stories.title: Desible.ai raises Rs 32 crore for financial AI tools
stories.summary: AI startup Desible.ai has raised Rs 32 crore in a Seed Plus round led by Prime Venture Partners. The company is building an AI-powered workflow orchestration platform for banks and insurance providers. The fresh capital will support product development and the expansion of its compliance infrastructure.

stories.title: Greenjoules secures Rs 150 crore for renewable fuel production
stories.summary: Pune-based Greenjoules has raised Rs 150 crore in a Series B round co-led by Amazon's Smbhav Venture Fund and Climate Pledge Fund. The company plans to increase production capacity for renewable fuels. It also secured a Rs 100 crore loan from the Technology Development Board.

stories.title: Bodhi Tree Systems acquires majority of Adyar Ananda Bhavan
stories.summary: Bodhi Tree Systems has acquired a majority stake in Adyar Ananda Bhavan for $180 million. The restaurant chain operates 160 outlets in India and 30 locations internationally. The investment platform was founded in 2021 by James Murdoch and Uday Shankar.

stories.title: LangChain hits $3 billion valuation in Series C round
stories.summary: AI startup LangChain has raised $300 million in a Series C round, reaching a $3 billion valuation. The company provides tools for managing AI agents across enterprise systems. Backers include CapitalG and GIC, with customers including NVIDIA, Toyota, and Salesforce.

stories.title: Norwest closes $4 billion investment fund
stories.summary: Global investment firm Norwest has closed its 18th fund at $4 billion, the largest in its 65-year history. The capital is earmarked for venture and growth equity investments across the technology, healthcare, and consumer sectors in India, Israel, and the United States.

stories.title: Dallas startup 4Minds closes Series A at $500 million valuation
stories.summary: Contextual AI startup 4Minds has raised $15 million in a Series A round at a $500 million valuation. The company extracts data from enterprise platforms into a GPU-accelerated knowledge graph, allowing businesses to deploy private AI models within their own cloud environments.

stories.title: Fractile raises $720 million to design AI chips
stories.summary: British startup Fractile has raised $720 million in a Series C round to design AI inference chips. The company is valued at over 5 billion pounds. The funding, backed by Britain's Sovereign AI Fund, aims to reduce the costs associated with running large language models.

stories.title: This Startup Raised $1 Billion to Build AI Faster and With Fewer Humans - WSJ
Nebuly raises $21 million to measure AI agent value
stories.summary: Turin-based startup Nebuly has raised $21 million in Series A funding led by Planven. The company provides tools for enterprises to measure the economic value of AI agents. Participants included Exor Ventures, Tenacity Capital, and a partnership between Fastweb and Vodafone.

stories.title: UFORCE raises €630 million at €5.4 billion valuation
stories.summary: Ukrainian drone manufacturer UFORCE has raised €630 million, valuing the company at €5.4 billion. The round was co-led by Valor Equity Partners and the UK National Wealth Fund. The company, which produces MAGURA sea drones, says it is already profitable. The valuation has grown roughly sixfold since 2026.

stories.title: Fractile raises $720 million with no production chip
stories.summary: London-based AI chip startup Fractile has raised $720 million in a Series C round, reportedly valuing the company at $7 billion. The firm has not yet shipped a production chip. Its design relies on stacking DRAM directly on top of logic to accelerate AI model responses.

stories.title: Drone startup Uforce raises $700m backed by Valor Equity Partners, UK National Wealth Fund
stories.summary: London-based defence startup Uforce, which builds autonomous drones for the land, air, and sea, has raised $700m in Series A funding co-led by the UK National Wealth Fund and Valor Equity Partners, confirming Sifted’s scoop from August that the startup was raising a large new round. News November 12, 2026

stories.title: SE3 Labs raises $30 million for spatial intelligence
stories.summary: German defence startup SE3 Labs has raised $30 million in Series A funding to expand its spatial intelligence software. The technology allows drones and unmanned vehicles to navigate terrain by fusing sensor data into a 3D battlefield map. The company emerged from stealth five months ago.

stories.title: Exclusive: SE3, a German startup building 'spatial intelligence' for military drones, raises $30 million Series A fundin
stories.summary: SE3, a Munich-based startup that makes AI software to help drones and other unmanned military systems understand the three-dimensional world around them, has raised $30 million in a Series A round led by Accel. Keen, Lakestar, and Seedcamp also participated in the funding round. It comes less than five months

stories.summary: Fractile has closed a $720 million Series C round led by Thrive, Founders Fund, Lightspeed and Redpoint. - Fractile is now worth $7 billion, up from around $1 billion in May, even though it hasn’t launched a production chip. - Fractile’s approach is to stack the DRAM on top of

stories.title: Planning minister discusses start-up financing with leading US venture capital funds
stories.summary: Planning and Economic Development Minister Ahmed Rostom held a series of meetings with senior executives from leading US venture capital funds and investment institutions at the conclusion of his participation in the B20 Summit 2026 in Washington, DC, to explore ways to attract foreign private sector investment into Egypt’s entrepreneurship

stories.title: Anup Gupta: Anup Gupta exits Nexus, latest in a wave of senior VC departures - The Economic Times
stories.summary: Anup Gupta, partner at Nexus Venture Partners who has backed companies such as recently listed Turtlemint, fintech startup Kiwi and ecommerce software firm Unicommerce, is set to leave the venture capital firm in June next year after a nearly 17-year stint, adding to a string of senior-level exits at Indiaâs

stories.title: Anup Gupta to exit Nexus Venture Partners
stories.summary: Anup Gupta is stepping down as a partner at Nexus Venture Partners in June 2027 after a 16-year tenure. Gupta, who previously worked as an operator and investor advisor, said he is passing on the baton to the team. He has not disclosed his future plans.

stories.title: The Consumer Capital 100: India’s Most Influential D2C Investors - Indian Startup Times
stories.summary: Introduction India’s Direct-to-Consumer (D2C) ecosystem has evolved into one of the country’s most dynamic startup segments, creating a new generation of consumer brands across beauty, fashion, food, wellness, lifestyle, and other categories. Behind this transformation is a growing network of investors who provide more than just capital, bringing strategic guidance,

stories.title: Ballistic Ventures seeks $490 million for cybersecurity funds
stories.summary: San Francisco-based Ballistic Ventures is seeking to raise $490 million across two new funds to invest in AI-driven cybersecurity technologies. Regulatory filings indicate the firm is targeting $360 million for its third flagship fund and $130 million for a separate vehicle. Neither fund has recorded sales yet.

stories.title: The Private Capital 100: India’s Most Influential VC & Family Office Leaders - Indian Startup Times
stories.summary: Introduction India’s private capital ecosystem is undergoing a remarkable transformation, driven by visionary investors who are shaping the flow of capital, innovation and entrepreneurship across the country. From venture capital firms backing high-growth startups to family offices taking a long-term approach to wealth creation, these leaders are playing an increasingly

stories.title: Focus, discipline and realised returns to define India
stories.summary: India's recognised startup base crossed 250,000 in October 2026, more than half of it beyond the metros. Domestic venture fundraising doubled to $5.4 billion in 2025. stories.summary: Top 10 Best Alternative Investment Funds in India in 2027 Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) have become an increasingly important part of India’s investment ecosystem, providing sophisticated investors with access to investment opportunities beyond conventional mutual funds, fixed deposits and publicly traded securities. US and Chinese VC models cannot be replicated in India, given differences in consumer behaviour, business dynamics

stories.title: L’Oréal’s Venture Fund Bold Appoints Jasjot Kaur As Investment Director For India - BW Disrupt
stories.summary: BOLD, the venture fund of L’Oréal, has appointed Jasjot Kaur as Investment Director for India. In her new role, Kaur will lead early-stage investments across the beauty, personal care and wellness sectors. Kaur joins BOLD from Nykaa, where she served as Associate Vice President, Strategy & M&A. She brings 12

stories.title: JSW Ventures marks first close of Fund III
stories.summary: JSW Ventures has reached the first close of its third fund, with the JSW Family Office serving as the anchor investor. The fund will target early-stage startups in the consumption, healthtech, fintech, and deeptech sectors. It will focus on investments at the Pre-Series A to Series A stages.

stories.title: Crystal Crop Protection IPO details
stories.summary: Crystal Crop Protection has set its IPO dates for November 18 to November 20, 2026. The company is offering shares in a price band of ₹259 to ₹272, aiming to raise ₹455.49 crore. The minimum investment is set at ₹14,960 per lot of 55 shares.

stories.title: Mahanadi Coalfields files RHP for ₹9,500 crore IPO
stories.summary: Mahanadi Coalfields has filed its Red Herring Prospectus to sell a 10% stake held by parent company Coal India. The proposed offer for sale of 66.18 crore shares is estimated to raise approximately ₹9,500 crore. The IPO remains subject to market conditions and regulatory approvals.

stories.title: DroneAcharya profits fall 65 percent
stories.summary: DroneAcharya reported a 65.3% decline in net profit to ₹67 lakh for the first half of fiscal year 2026-27, down from ₹1.9 crore in the year-ago period. Operating revenue fell 18.3% to ₹7.8 crore. The company previously reported a net loss in the second half of last year.

stories.title: Razorpay clears SEBI review for an India IPO reported at up to 6,000 crore rupees - MLQ.ai
FirstCry revenue grows 14 percent
stories.summary: Brainbees Solutions, the parent company of FirstCry, reported a 14% year-on-year increase in operating revenue to ₹2,396 crore for the September quarter. The company narrowed its net loss to ₹12.6 crore, down from ₹51 crore in the same period last year.

stories.title: FirstCry net loss narrows to ₹12.6 crore
stories.summary: FirstCry parent Brainbees Solutions reported a 14.1% rise in operating revenue to ₹2,395.8 crore for the second quarter of fiscal year 2026-27. The company narrowed its net loss by 75.1% to ₹12.6 crore compared to the year-ago quarter. Profitability remains a future prospect.

stories.title: Razorpay receives SEBI approval for IPO
stories.summary: Fintech company Razorpay has received SEBI approval to proceed with an IPO expected to raise between ₹5,000 crore and ₹6,000 crore. The listing is anticipated in the first quarter of 2027. The company could be valued at approximately $5 billion.

stories.title: Razorpay clears SEBI hurdle for IPO
stories.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India has issued observations on Razorpay’s draft IPO papers, allowing the fintech firm to proceed with its public issue. The company aims to raise up to ₹6,000 crore, with a potential valuation of $5 billion.

stories.title: Razorpay secures green light for IPO
stories.summary: Market regulator SEBI has approved Razorpay’s proposal to raise $600 million through an initial public offering. The company previously submitted its draft documents through a confidential filing process to protect sensitive business strategies. The regulator has now cleared the company to move forward.

stories.title: Q2 results show mixed performance for listed firms
stories.summary: Several companies released second-quarter results on November 13, 2026. Tata Motors PV, Grasim, and Religare Enterprises reported losses for the period. Conversely, Eicher Motors, Gillette India, Shriram Properties, Pushpa Jewellers, Edelweiss Financial Services, and Manipal Hospitals posted gains.

stories.title: Razorpay and Sembcorp Green Infra receive IPO approval
stories.summary: Razorpay and Sembcorp Green Infra have secured SEBI approval to launch their respective initial public offerings. Razorpay filed its draft documents confidentially in June, while Sembcorp Green Infra filed preliminary papers in August to raise up to ₹3,750 crore.

stories.title: Razorpay and Sembcorp Green Infra clear IPO regulatory review
stories.summary: SEBI has cleared the IPO plans for Razorpay and Sembcorp Green Infra, alongside MakeMyTrip’s Indian subsidiary. The regulator issued final observations for the companies between November 3 and November 13. These approvals allow the firms to begin preparations for their public offerings.

stories.title: Schoolgirls launch 3D printing and ornament startups
stories.summary: Two schoolgirls from Hubballi-Dharwad have started businesses in 3D-printed products and fabric ornaments. One student invested ₹6 to 7 lakh in a 3D printer to produce lamps after watching online tutorials. The students are now managing their own manufacturing operations.

stories.title: Karnataka launches initiative to support regional startups
stories.summary: The Karnataka government has launched the Beyond Bengaluru initiative to encourage startup growth outside the state capital. The scheme offers financial assistance of up to ₹1 crore to selected ventures. Currently, 72% of the state's startups are based in Bengaluru.

stories.title: Indian Army veteran joins CoSarathi.ai
stories.summary: Y Suresh Kumar, a veteran with 21 years of service in the Indian Army, has joined AI startup CoSarathi.ai as co-founder and chief marketing and operating officer. He will oversee business operations and strategic execution as the company looks to expand its technology offerings.

stories.title: Noel Tata addresses execution challenges at leadership summit
stories.summary: Tata Trusts chairman Noel Tata stated that the conglomerate must improve execution discipline and capital allocation for large projects. Speaking at the Hindustan Times Leadership Summit, he outlined plans to make philanthropic initiatives more outcome-oriented, including a proposed network of hospitals in underserved regions.

stories.title: Incubator founder reflects on startup support in Northeast
stories.summary: Prof. Tej Chingtham established AIC-SMUTBI to support entrepreneurs in Northeast India. The incubator has mentored over 200 ventures, addressing a previous lack of regional support systems for young people attempting to build businesses. The initiative aims to provide the resources necessary for local startup development.

stories.title: Couple leaves IT to launch meal subscription startup
stories.summary: A Bengaluru couple launched a meal subscription startup after finding it difficult to source affordable home-style food. The business has served 55,000 meals and generated ₹56 lakh in revenue over nine months. The founders previously worked in the IT sector.

stories.title: iD Fresh Food launches entrepreneurship policy for staff
stories.summary: iD Fresh Food is encouraging employees to quit the corporate path to build their own businesses. CEO Musthafa P says the company will support staff in these ventures and even offers them the option of returning. Most companies try to retain their best employees, but this one prefers them elsewhere.

stories.title: Bengaluru couple launches healthy-meal service
stories.summary: Diya Krishnakumar and Adithya Natarajan invested Rs 15 lakh to launch a healthy-meal service after struggling to find nutritious options as IT professionals. The venture earned Rs 56 lakh between January and September 2026 and has delivered more than 55,000 meals. Homemade food is now a scalable business.

stories.title: Microsoft outage disrupts global workplaces
stories.summary: Problems with Exchange Online spread across Microsoft 365 and external businesses on November 12, affecting calendars and workplace tools. The disruption continued into November 13, highlighting the reliance of modern offices on shared cloud infrastructure. Outlook is no longer the official start of the working day.

stories.title: Startup launches AI-powered Blue phone
stories.summary: Startup Blue has introduced a phone run by AI, claiming it can replace the iPhone. Founder Omar Abdelaziz says the first batch has sold out and that users do not want to return to their previous devices. The company is backed by Y Combinator and 70 other investors.

stories.title: AI shifts India outsourcing model toward small teams
stories.summary: AI is enabling small Indian teams to handle global projects that previously required large companies by automating tasks like rotoscoping and project management. As AI separates capability from headcount, small agencies are taking on work that once necessitated outside freelancers. The export story is getting smaller.

stories.title: Book excerpt details Indian immigrant entrepreneurship
stories.summary: Since the 1980s, Indian immigrants in the US have moved from traditional corporate roles toward founding companies. The trend includes figures like Vinod Khosla and Kanwal Rekhi, who helped establish firms such as Sun Microsystems and Excelan. The path to a billion-dollar startup is well documented.

research.summary: Scientists have developed an AI-powered approach that makes experimental bionic vision technology more precise, helping predict the flashes and shapes of light perceived by a blind man with a brain implant.
